text: これこそ　しんの　ポケモンの　れきしに　のこる　いだいな　しごとじゃー！

structure.jp: しんの　ポケモンの　れきしに　のこる
structure.en: that will remain in true Pokémon history

structure.jp: いだいな　しごとじゃー！

patterns.name: 〜こそ
patterns.explanation: こそ puts strong weight on the word before it, like 'this very one'. これこそ = 'this is truly the one'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: れきしに　のこる　いだいな　しごと
patterns.explanation: The phrase ending in a verb describes the thing that comes after it. れきしに　のこる　いだいな　しごと = 'a great work that will remain in history'.

patterns.name: 〜だ
patterns.explanation: じゃ is the old-man way of saying だ, 'is', drawn out here with excitement. しごとじゃー = 'it is a work!'.
